query: Which clinical factors best explain longer visit durations?

per_column.name: primary_complaint_type
per_column.rationale: Clinically meaningful categorisation (chronic/acute/preventive/emergency) that gives a strong grouping axis for explaining duration. Samples map soundly: annual exam->preventive, MI follow-up->chronic, cough->acute_urgent.

per_column.name: diagnostic_workup_required
per_column.rationale: Workup intensity is a plausible driver of visit length and well grounded in ordered labs/imaging. Minor concern: a single MRI order tagged 'extensive_labs_imaging' is slightly generous, but readings are largely warranted.

per_column.name: multisystem_involvement
per_column.rationale: Reasonable axis, but several readings are questionable. Annual exam with only fatigue labeled multisystem=True is weakly supported; MI follow-up as True is defensible. The boolean is inconsistently justified from text.

per_column.name: vital_sign_abnormality_present
per_column.rationale: Potentially useful, but grounding is poor. BP 128/82 and BMI 27 are normal yet flagged True; fever 38.1C flagged True is correct. Contradictory reading on the first sample indicates hallucinated abnormality.

per_column.name: procedure_or_intervention_performed
per_column.rationale: Intervention type is a strong candidate driver of duration. But the knee case with only an MRI order labeled 'invasive_procedure' is unsupported/contradictory; no invasive procedure was performed. Other samples map well.

per_column.name: medication_initiation_or_adjustment
per_column.rationale: Meaningful axis; most samples grounded (adapalene/doxycycline->new; continue regimen->stopped_or_continued). But annual exam labeled new_medication_started is unsupported by the text.

per_column.name: patient_age_group
per_column.rationale: Largely redundant with the existing original age_group column, adding little analytical leverage. Values are also inferred where the source text rarely states age explicitly, making them uncertain.

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Follow-up vs new-problem vs preventive is a genuine, useful axis for duration and partially derivable from department/urgency but adds granularity. Sample mappings are sound and well grounded.

judge.rationale: Most added columns provide genuine clinical axes (complaint type, workup intensity, procedures, medication changes, visit type) directly relevant to explaining visit duration. Weaknesses: patient_age_group is redundant with the existing age_group column, and several columns show grounding problems where values assert specifics unsupported by or contradicting the source text (normal vitals flagged abnormal, an MRI order labeled invasive procedure, a preventive exam labeled new medication started). Grounding is acceptable but noticeably weakened by these over-confident inferences.
